hooks.command: f=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *src/*.test.ts|*src/test-preload.ts|*src/testDom.ts) ;; *src/*.ts) t="${f%.ts}.test.ts"; if [ -f "$t" ]; then bun test "$t" 2>&1 | tail -5; else echo "[hook] no test file at ${t#*src/} — this source file is outside the auto-test net"; fi;; esac; exit 0
